grouping: connected normalized query or whitespace-normalized exact code; no claim of exhaustive semantic clone detection
selection: group order by SHA256(seed + canonical group key); ignore labels and model scores
evaluation: query-code binary relevance, not candidate retrieval
threshold: maximize calibration balanced accuracy, ties choose larger threshold
fallback: out-of-scope model inputs use BM25 prediction with its calibration threshold; all final rows retained
uncertainty: 500 paired connected-group bootstrap replicates, seed1729; 95% percentile interval of balanced accuracy difference vs BM25
models: all 8 archived synthetic probe exports, no CoSQA training or model selection
go_no_go: usefulness remains unproven without retrieval/agent evaluation; model candidate needs positive lower CI for balanced-accuracy delta vs BM25 and no hidden exclusions
